findings.motion: HB 1074, Constitutional Amendment/Citizens-Only Voting, primary sponsor (introduced and passed first reading 2024-05-24; ratified 2024-06-28 as S.L. 2024-18)
findings.note: Gillespie is listed as primary sponsor. The act amends Article VI, Section 1 of the state constitution so that only a citizen of the United States who is 18 or older and otherwise qualified may vote, and sends the change to voters on the November 5, 2024 ballot. The House passed it 99-12 on third reading on 2024-06-27.

findings.motion: HB 958, Election Law Changes, House concurrence in the Senate committee substitute (62-47). Gillespie voted Aye. He also voted Aye on second reading on 2026-06-30 (66-47).
findings.note: The ratified bill (see https://www.ncleg.gov/BillLookUp/2025/H958) makes various election-law changes. These include a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens by a federal database, and a rule that a voter registration application is processed only if it affirmatively says the applicant is a US citizen, with a notice and sworn statement for applications that leave the question blank. The governor vetoed it on 2026-08-17. It was placed on the House calendar for 2026-09-02 (veto-override stage).
